title: Choose, switch and recover acknowledged research
description: Four saved commanders submit real research orders through keyboard controls. Receipts bind original payloads and effective ticks. Reload recovers accepted authority; a second device holds its original command while another order makes its revision stale for rejection. The guarded demo clock changes only designated domain time. Labelled leased tick delivery verifies completion, retained overflow and the following-tick Innovation effect; hosted scheduling and proposed rules remain unapproved.
